data.title: 萝丝 · 晨光寝殿的蕾丝披肩与初醒
data.description: 晨光柔和地洒满雕花实木大床。萝丝身披轻柔纯白的半透明蕾丝披肩缓缓坐起身，微卷的金色长发随意散在肩头。她揉了揉微涩的眼角，回眸看见身旁的少年，露出了如初雪消融般的幸福浅笑。
data.location: spacious sun-drenched bridal bedroom with carved wooden bed and white pillows
data.action: sitting up in bed, sheer lace shawl draped over shoulders, rubbing one eye delicately, soft disheveled morning hair, gentle blissful smile looking over
data.lighting: soft morning sunbeams diffusing through lace curtains onto rumpled bed linens
data.mood: innocent newlywed warmth, heavenly morning tranquility, profound sweet devotion
data.promptProse: In a tranquil sunlit bedroom, blonde princess Rose Oriana sits up among white pillows draped in a sheer lace shawl, looking over with a sleepy, deeply affectionate morning smile.
data.animaCaption: Sitting up among the sunlit white pillows draped in sheer lace, she smiles with sleepy morning tenderness.
